name: Progress Ajayi
biography:
Progress Ajayi is a physiologist and bioinformatician with a first-class undergraduate qualification in Physiology and a master’s qualification in Human Physiology awarded with distinction. He is pursuing a PhD in Molecular Biology and Genomics.

His interests include bioinformatics, clinical and experimental data analysis, research software development, and clear scientific reporting.
qualifications: Undergraduate qualification in Physiology — First Class.
Master’s qualification in Human Physiology — Distinction.
PhD in Molecular Biology and Genomics — in progress.
